events.title: Demo added to libraries over 50,000 times! A cape gift to say thank you
events.summary: The SLAM TANK demo has been added to Steam libraries over 50,000 times! A heartfelt thank you to everyone who's joined us. To thank you for your support, we're preparing an event where you can receive a cosmetic cape to customize your tank in the full game as a gift. The dates shown on the cover image are the dates of Steam Next Fest. We'll announce the participation period for our cape thank-you event and how the reward will be distributed at a later date. https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/im

events.title: Streaming and videos of the SLAM TANK demo are welcome!
events.summary: We've been receiving many questions about streaming and posting videos of the SLAM TANK demo. We've added this information to our store page and are sharing it here as well. Individuals and organizations may freely stream or post videos of any part of the SLAM TANK demo and use platform monetization features, with no need to contact us in advance.
